No `[CUSTOM COMPONENT NEEDED]` items — Chakra UI 2's existing catalog covers every requirement.

## Screen Inventory

### Screen: Dashboard

**Route:** `/` (existing stub: `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`)
**Entry point:** App load / nav bar "Dashboard" link
**Primary user stories:** S1, S2, S6, S8 (S9 links out from here)

**Layout:**
- Header: page `Heading` "Factory Overview" + `LiveIndicator` (right-aligned)
- Attention banner (`ChakraAlert`) directly below the header
- KPI row: `SimpleGrid` of 4 `StatTile`s (Connection, Machines, Zones, Uptime)
- Machine status breakdown row (small stat group)
- "Zone Health" `Heading`, then `SimpleGrid` of `ZoneHealthCard`s, sorted worst-first

**Design System Components used:**
- `Stat`, `SimpleGrid`, `Card`, `Badge`, `Skeleton`, `ChakraAlert`, `LinkBox`

**Key interactions on this screen:**
- Page load → `useFactoryStatus`, `useZones`, `useAllMachines`, `useActiveAlerts()` fire → skeletons show until resolved
- Click attention banner or "View alerts" → navigate to `/alerts`
- Click a zone card → navigate to `/alerts?zone={zoneId}`

**Data requirements:** `FactoryStatus`, `Zone[]`, `Machine[]` (via `useAllMachines`), normalized `Alert[]` grouped by zone

---

### Screen: Alerts (Active Problems)

**Route:** `/alerts` (existing stub: `src/pages/Alerts.tsx`)
**Entry point:** Nav bar link, Dashboard attention banner, or a zone card (arrives with `?zone=` set)
**Primary user stories:** S3, S4, S5, S7, S11

**Layout:**
- Header: `Heading` "Active Problems" + unacknowledged count
- Severity summary chips (`Tag` row: Critical N · Warning N · Info N)
- Filter bar: zone `Select`, show-acknowledged `Switch`, group/flat `ButtonGroup`, search `Input` (if time allows)
- New-alerts pill (appears only when live alerts are queued, FR-023)
- Main content: grouped-by-machine cards (default) or flat `Table` (toggle), with a collapsed "N info alerts" section
- Empty state block when the filtered list is empty

**Design System Components used:**
- `Tag`, `Select`, `Switch`, `ButtonGroup`, `Card`, `Collapse`, `Table`, `Badge`, `Button`, `useToast`

**Key interactions on this screen:**
- Change any filter → list updates immediately, no submit
- Click a severity chip → toggles that severity into/out of the filter
- Click "Acknowledge" on a row → `useAcknowledgeAlert().mutate` (or local ack for `ws-alt-*`) → toast → row updates
- Click "Acknowledge all" on a group → `Promise.allSettled` over the group's unacknowledged ids → summary toast
- New live alert arrives → merges immediately if the visible list is short, otherwise queues behind the "N new alerts" pill; critical always toasts

**Data requirements:** normalized/merged `Alert[]` (REST + live), `Zone[]` (filter options)

---

### Screen: Topology (stretch)

**Route:** `/topology` (existing stub: `src/pages/Topology.tsx`)
**Entry point:** Nav bar link
**Primary user story:** S10

**Layout:**
- Header: `Heading` "Factory Topology"
- `SimpleGrid` of 4 zone region `Card`s, each with a `Wrap` of machine tiles inside

**Design System Components used:** `Card`, `Wrap`, `Box`, `Tooltip`, `Badge`

**Key interactions on this screen:**
- Hover a machine tile → `Tooltip` shows latest telemetry (temperature, vibration, throughput, power draw, timestamp) from the shared live provider
- Telemetry message arrives for a visible machine → tile briefly flashes

**Data requirements:** `Zone[]`, `Machine[]` (via `useAllMachines`), live telemetry map from `useLive()`

## Testable User Journeys

### Journey: Factory Overview at a glance (S1)
**Entry point:** `/`
**Happy path:**
1. User navigates to `/` — *validation: skeletons appear briefly, then resolve*
2. KPI row shows Connected=Live, Machines=14, Zones=4, Uptime=`127.4h` — *validation: values match `/api/factory/status`*
3. User reads the connection badge — *validation: green "Live" when `connected: true`*

**Edge cases to test:** API error on `useFactoryStatus` → inline error message, not a blank page.
**Fail fast criteria:** If an operator can't state the floor's connection status and machine count within 5 seconds of the page loading, the KPI layout has failed its purpose.

### Journey: Spot the top problem and act (S2, S3, S5)
**Entry point:** `/`
**Happy path:**
1. User lands on `/` — *validation: attention banner reads "2 critical · 2 warning unacknowledged"*
2. User clicks the banner — *validation: navigates to `/alerts` with no filter*
3. Alerts list shows `press-01` hydraulic fault (critical) at the top — *validation: sort places critical+unacked first*
4. User clicks "Acknowledge" on that row — *validation: button shows a pending state, then a success toast, then the row shows "Acknowledged"*

**Edge cases to test:** Acknowledge request fails → error toast, row remains actionable. `alt-005`'s bad timestamp → displays "Unknown time", doesn't crash the sort.
**Fail fast criteria:** If acknowledging requires more than one click or the row doesn't visibly update, the interaction has failed.

### Journey: Triage a bad day (50+ alerts) (S11)
**Entry point:** `/alerts`, after running `window.__setAlertScenario("stress")` in the console
**Happy path:**
1. User opens `/alerts` — *validation: chips read Critical 10 · Warning 21 · Info 19*
2. List renders as 14 machine groups (default grouped view), not 50 flat rows — *validation: group count = 14*
3. User clicks the "Critical" chip — *validation: only groups containing a critical alert remain*
4. User expands `press-01`'s group and clicks "Acknowledge all" — *validation: all of `press-01`'s alerts move to acknowledged, one summary toast fires*

**Edge cases to test:** `window.__setAlertScenario("empty")` → empty-state message, no errors. Switching to flat view mid-filter keeps the same filters applied.
**Fail fast criteria:** If the operator still has to scroll through more than ~15 visual units to find all critical issues at 50 alerts, the grouping/chip design hasn't solved the stated volume problem.

### Journey: Zone health drives attention (S6, S9)
**Entry point:** `/`
**Happy path:**
1. User scans the Zone Health grid — *validation: Packaging (faulted) card appears before Assembly/Painting (healthy)*
2. User clicks the Packaging card — *validation: navigates to `/alerts?zone=packaging`*
3. Alerts list is pre-filtered to Packaging — *validation: zone `Select` shows "Packaging" selected*

**Edge cases to test:** A zone with zero open alerts still shows a card with "0 open".
**Fail fast criteria:** If the worst zone isn't visually first, the ranking has failed.

### Journey: Real-time awareness (S7, S8)
**Entry point:** `/alerts`, left open and watched
**Happy path:**
1. User watches the page for up to ~45 seconds — *validation: a new alert row appears (or queues behind the "N new alerts" pill on a long list) without a manual refresh*
2. If the new alert is critical — *validation: a toast fires immediately regardless of the pill state*
3. User acknowledges the new alert — *validation: works the same as a REST alert, including for `ws-alt-*` ids (local-only ack)*

**Edge cases to test:** Multiple live alerts arriving in quick succession dedupe correctly and don't duplicate on a component re-render.
**Fail fast criteria:** If the operator has to refresh the page to see a new critical problem, real-time awareness has failed.

```tsx
// src/live/LiveProvider.tsx — single WebSocket subscription for the whole app (FR-013, FR-014)
export function LiveProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [liveAlerts, setLiveAlerts] = useState<Alert[]>([]);
  const [telemetry, setTelemetry] = useState<Record<string, TelemetrySnapshot>>({});
  const [lastMessageAt, setLastMessageAt] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useFactoryWebSocket((message) => {
    setLastMessageAt(Date.now());
    if (message.type === "alert") {
      setLiveAlerts((prev) => dedupeById([...prev, message.payload]));
    } else if (message.type === "telemetry") {
      setTelemetry((prev) => ({ ...prev, [message.payload.machineId]: message.payload }));
    }
  });

  return <LiveContext.Provider value={{ liveAlerts, telemetry, lastMessageAt }}>{children}</LiveContext.Provider>;
}
```

```tsx
// src/hooks/useActiveAlerts.ts — merges REST + live, normalizes, sorts (FR-006, FR-010, FR-013)
export function useActiveAlerts(filters?: { severity?: string; zone?: string }) {
  const { data: restAlerts, isLoading, isError } = useAlerts(filters);
  const { liveAlerts } = useLive();
  const { data: zones } = useZones();
  const acknowledge = useAcknowledgeAlert();

  const alerts = useMemo(() => {
    const zoneById = new Map((zones ?? []).map((z) => [z.id, z]));
    const merged = dedupeById([...(restAlerts ?? []), ...liveAlerts]);
    return sortAlerts(merged.map((a) => normalizeAlert(a, zoneById)));
  }, [restAlerts, liveAlerts, zones]);

  function acknowledgeAlert(id: string) {
    if (id.startsWith("ws-alt-")) { /* local-only ack, see PRT Q2 */ }
    else acknowledge.mutate(id);
  }

  return { alerts, isLoading, isError, acknowledgeAlert, acknowledgePending: acknowledge.isPending };
}
```

```tsx
// src/pages/Alerts.tsx — screen composition (abbreviated)
export function Alerts() {
  const [severity, setSeverity] = useState<string>();
  const [zone, setZone] = useSearchParamState("zone");
  const [showAcked, setShowAcked] = useState(false);
  const [view, setView] = useState<"grouped" | "flat">("grouped");
  const { alerts, isLoading, isError, acknowledgeAlert } = useActiveAlerts({ severity, zone });

  const visible = useMemo(() => showAcked ? alerts : alerts.filter(a => !a.acknowledged), [alerts, showAcked]);
  const groups = useMemo(() => groupByMachine(visible), [visible]);

  return (
    <Container maxW="container.xl" py={6}>
      <Heading mb={4}>Active Problems</Heading>
      <SeverityChips alerts={alerts} active={severity} onChange={setSeverity} />
      <FilterBar zone={zone} onZone={setZone} showAcked={showAcked} onShowAcked={setShowAcked} view={view} onView={setView} />
      {isLoading && <AlertsSkeleton />}
      {isError && <ChakraAlert status="error">Couldn't load alerts.</ChakraAlert>}
      {!isLoading && visible.length === 0 && <EmptyState />}
      {view === "grouped"
        ? groups.map(g => <MachineAlertGroup key={g.machineId} group={g} onAcknowledge={acknowledgeAlert} />)
        : <AlertsTable alerts={visible} onAcknowledge={acknowledgeAlert} />}
    </Container>
  );
}
```

> Real component bindings (Chakra UI React components) are used directly — no CSS class names, per the note in the standard prototype-spec template.

## Open Questions for Design/Product

- None blocking — Chakra UI 2's existing components fully cover this feature. The two open PRT questions (Q1: zone health source of truth, Q2: live-alert acknowledge persistence) are UX/product decisions, not component-availability gaps, and are answered in PRT Section 10 for the purposes of this build.
